lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of white circular blobs posterior to the gill slits. The spots are most densely clustered in the mid-lateral section, with an average spacing of roughly 1.5 to 2 blob diameters between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of high-luminance spots align to form a grid-like pattern; the intersection nodes are defined by individual blobs centered on these vertical and horizontal axes of alignment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by bright highlights along the crest and high-contrast shadows immediately ventral, extending from the gill region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial concentration observed towards the leading edge of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, healed semi-circular indentation or notch is clearly visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating an acquired amputation or significant tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three remoras (Echeneidae) swimming in close proximity to the ventral flank and pectoral fin; additionally, the snout region anterior to the gills displays a high density of significantly smaller, concentrated white spots.
